# CollapsiblePanel

**Class:** `UltraCanvasCollapsiblePanel` · **Group:** [Layout and structure](../Groups/Layout-and-structure.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasCollapsiblePanel.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasCollapsiblePanel.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasCollapsiblePanel.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasContainer`](UltraCanvasContainer.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

A panel that folds to its header - a download queue, a log, a problems list docked at the bottom, with a chevron, a detail text, header buttons and a resizable top edge ([doc](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasCollapsiblePanel.md))

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasCollapsiblePanel](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasCollapsiblePanel.md)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasCollapsiblePanel> CreateCollapsiblePanel(const std::string& identifier, const std::string& title = "");
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasCollapsiblePanel> CreateCollapsiblePanel(const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h, const std::string& title = "");
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasCollapsiblePanel(const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h, const std::string& title = "");
UltraCanvasCollapsiblePanel(const std::string& identifier, float w, float h, const std::string& title = "");
explicit UltraCanvasCollapsiblePanel(const std::string& identifier, const std::string& title = "");
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `AddHeaderButton()` | `std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasButton> AddHeaderButton(const std::string& id, const std::string& text, std::function<void()> onClick, float minWidth = 64.0f)` | A real button there, wired to onClick; returned for styling. |
| `onExpandedChanged` | `std::function<void(bool expanded)> onExpandedChanged` | _Expanded changed_ |
| `onExpandedHeightChanged` | `std::function<void(float height)> onExpandedHeightChanged` | after a drag |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasContainer`](UltraCanvasContainer.md): `SetScrollChangedCallback`, `SetChildAddedCallback`, `SetChildRemovedCallback`
- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`
